name: firepixel-click-id-checker
description: Chrome extension (MV3) that checks whether a landing page keeps the Google Ads or Microsoft Ads click ID.
author: Ben Luong, CopperChunk Limited, trading as Fire Pixel

scripts.lint:syntax: node --check popup/popup.js && node --check src/snapshot.js && node --check src/analyse.js
scripts.zip: rm -f dist/firepixel-click-id-checker-1.0.0.zip && mkdir -p dist && zip -r -X dist/firepixel-click-id-checker-1.0.0.zip manifest.json src popup icons -x '*.DS_Store' '*/.*'
